name: Avokaado
description_en:
Avokaado coordinates contract creation, collaboration, signing, structured data and obligations in a workspace. The goal is self-service for business teams while legal controls templates and approvals. Avo AI and registry functions extend the family, but the selected modules must be agreed explicitly. Marketing claims of error-free automation are not a substitute for reviewing the organization’s clauses and approval rules.

The contracting page describes adding smart fields and conditions, pre-approving clauses and locking critical sections. Business users fill a form, data populates the document, and rules choose approvers before signing and storage. A pilot NDA could exercise one normal case and one exception requiring legal review. Confirm that invalid inputs trigger the intended review and that exported Word/PDF copies retain the required version and metadata. This is a proposed test, not legal validation or hands-on evidence.
description_zh:
Avokaado 在工作区中协调合同创建、协作、签署、结构化数据与义务管理。目标是让业务团队自助处理，同时由法务控制模板与批准。Avo AI 和登记功能扩展了产品家族，但选用模块需明确约定。无错误自动化等宣传不能代替对本组织条款与批准规则的审查。

合同页描述智能字段与条件、预批准条款及关键段落锁定。业务用户填写表单，数据填入文件，再由规则选择批准人，最后签署存储。NDA 试点可包含一个普通案例和一个需法务审查的例外。应确认无效输入能触发预期审查，导出的 Word／PDF 保留所需版本及元数据。这是测试建议，不是法律核验或实测证据。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate contracts from smart fields, locked clauses and rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过智能字段、锁定条款与规则生成合同。

core_features.explanation_en: Route requests to approvers before signing and structured storage.
core_features.explanation_zh: 签署与结构化存储前把申请交给批准人。

en: Turn an approved template into a controlled request
zh: 把批准模板变成受控申请
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

Business users fill a form, data populates the document, and rules choose approvers before signing and storage. A pilot NDA could exercise one normal case and one exception requiring legal review. items.en: Avokaado fits repeatable legal, HR, revenue and procurement documents when someone owns the approved language and exceptions. A one-off bespoke negotiation may still need direct legal drafting. Cloud or on-premise options are advertised, but on-premise availability does not imply an open-source license; deployment terms remain contractual. Audit trails and governed fields help trace workflow, but precise rollback, signing failure and external access behavior were not tested.
items.zh: 当有人负责批准文本与例外时，Avokaado 适合重复性的法务、HR、营收及采购文件。一次性复杂谈判仍可能需要直接法务起草。官网宣传云端或本地部署，但本地可用不代表开源许可，部署条件仍由合同决定。审计轨迹与受控字段有助于追踪流程，精确回滚、签署失败和外部访问行为未经本次测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page says there are no fixed plans and asks buyers to define workflows, teams and tools. Listed modules include signing providers, AI extraction, migration, clause management, workspaces, SSO and on-premise deployment. Exact fees, usage units and signature-provider costs were not published in the retrieved view. A demo is offered, but no perpetual free tier or general trial term was established. Obtain a quote covering template setup, migration, integrations and support rather than pricing only document count.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页表示没有固定套餐，要求买家说明流程、团队与工具。模块清单包括签名供应商、AI 提取、迁移、条款管理、工作区、SSO 与本地部署。本次可读页面未公布具体收费、用量单位或签名供应商费用。官网提供演示，但未确认长期免费层或通用试用期限。报价应覆盖模板设置、迁移、集成与支持，不宜只按文件数预算。
